name: Tractor
summary: Chinese partnership trick-taking climb game with double deck where tractor pairs win points and level up past Ace.
rules_text: Four players in fixed opposite partnerships use 108 cards (two 52s + 4 jokers). 25 cards each, 8 face down as kitty. Trump rank equals declarers' current level, starting at 2. During deal a player may expose one or two identical trump-rank cards or joker pair to set or nullify trump suit; highest exposure wins and that player becomes starter, takes kitty and discards 8 face down. Trump order: red jokers > black jokers > trump-rank of trump-suit > other trump-rank equal > remaining trump-suit A-K high to 2 low. Other suits A to 2 omitting trump rank. Starter leads. Tricks may be single, pair, or tractor (consecutive pairs in same suit). Must follow suit and follow combination type if possible; otherwise may play any cards but not beat trick. Highest trump wins, else highest card of led suit. Kings and Tens 10 points, Fives 5 points, total 200. Kitty points double for winner of last trick. Opponents need 80 to win and become next declarers. Declarers level up by points denied. First partnership beyond Ace wins match.
